question: Who among the following had written the book ‘Char Chaman’, during the reign of Shah Jahan, describing the Mughal nobility?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandrabhan Brahman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chandrabhan Brahmin wrote the book 'Char Chaman' describing the Mughal nobility during the reign of Shah Jahan**__.

 
 
• Chander Bhan Brahmin was a scribe who served in the Mughal court from the 1630s to the 1660s.
